parse_move_from_response: parse a raw LLM response string to extract a game move using Final Answer tags and LaTeX formatting
test_parse_move_from_response: test parse_move_from_response with trailing whitespace, boxed LaTeX answers, and HTML tags to verify correct move extraction
chess_soft_parser_v1: parse a chess move string against a board state and list of legal SAN moves to validate and normalize it
test_chess_soft_parser_v1: test chess_soft_parser_v1 with castling notation, en passant, move numbers, and ambiguous moves to verify correct parsing
chained_move_parser: chain multiple TextParser instances together to successively refine raw LLM output into a validated game move
